    MeetRonak Patiyat

    Hi, I'm Ronak — a keyboardist and singer trained at one of Mumbai's leading music institutes. The 8th Note is my personalised, one-on-one way of teaching piano, harmonium and vocals: fun, interactive and creative, and built around what you actually want to play. I teach students 10 and above, in person in Bengaluru or live from the comfort of your home — and I also perform devotional music at Jain and spiritual events.

    About THE8THNOTE

    Every idea deserves the right note.

    THE8THNOTE is where it begins.

    What started with a journey to Mumbai to learn, explore and express through music grew into a space where different sides of music could come together. From singing and piano to spiritual and bhakti music, THE8THNOTE is about discovering the many ways music can become a part of who we are.

    Mission

    To make music simple, joyful and personal — one-on-one piano, harmonium and vocal lessons that help every student play and sing Jain stavans, bhajans and songs with confidence.

    Vision

    A home for devotional music, where every learner — in Bengaluru or anywhere in India — can grow from their very first note to performing with devotion on stage.

    Personality

    Patient, warm and devoted. Classes are fun, interactive and creative, built on sur, taal and regular riyaaz, with respect for every student's own pace.

    Our culture &
    work style

    At THE8THNOTE, music is learnt the way it should be — personally. Every class is one-on-one, built around what you want to play and sing, at a pace that feels right for you. We keep it honest, patient and encouraging, whether you are touching the keys for the first time or preparing a stavan for a pooja.

    We believe music grows with devotion, practice and a happy mind. That's why every lesson is fun, interactive and creative — real songs, steady riyaaz and the freedom to ask anything. Respect for the music, the guru and each other, and a love for bhakti — that's the note we live by.
